title: Spam Detection System
summary: A college project implementing a spam detection system that preprocesses email text, trains multiple classifiers (Naive Bayes, SVM, Random Forest, KNN), and serves predictions via a FastAPI app; the only SDV-pattern match is an incidental substring 'sdv' inside an unrelated conda cache file path in requirements.txt, not an actual use of the SDV library.
evidence: requirements.txt: 'more-itertools @ file:///.../abs_e2687gwsdv/...' contains 'sdv' as an incidental substring, no SDV package referenced
